Name: Pale Ale Alternative - Pam Quest Edit
Author: AirynS
Description:
A different take on Jonqora's [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/6721]Don't Enable Pam[/url], Pale Ale Alternative adds a different way of completing the "Pam is Thirsty" quest so that players don't have to give her alcohol. 

Penny will send a letter asking the farmer to give Pam vegetable juice instead, but whether or not Pam accepts it depends on how much of a friend she considers you. Will you risk it? Or stick to the easy option and give Pam what she wants?

[b][size=5]INSTALLATION[/size][/b]

Simply extract the "[CP] Pale Ale Alternative" folder and drop it into your Mods folder. Pale Ale Alternative can be installed mid-game even if you already have the "Pam is Thirsty" quest, as long as you haven't completed it.

[b][size=5]CREDITS[/size][/b]

Thanks to Jonqora for the original idea! This version has fully original code and writing, but it wouldn't exist without Don't Enable Pam.

Portraits in screenshots are from [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/17059]Diverse Stardew Valley.[/url]
